Loblolly: When I come up with some good
designs, please help me again!

Loblolly: Oh, are you going to help me
with my dream Décor design?{VAR BE01}
Great! Which of these Décor items would
you dream about?

Well, if you'd like to give me your opinion
on my dream Décor, please come back!

Everybody is talking about Décor
they dream about. Do you know it?
